meta.method: Web search (snippet-level) on 2026-11-10; direct page fetch blocked by network policy; items marked 'prior-knowledge' not re-verified. Maturity ladder 1 Announced – 6 Measurable volume/incremental value; ratings of 6 rest on company claims only.

timeline.title: ChatGPT released
timeline.significance: Start of generative-AI commercialization; the access layer that later shopping features ride on.

timeline.title: ChatGPT plugins launch incl. Instacart, Shopify, Klarna, Expedia
timeline.significance: First attempt to route commerce through a chat assistant; plugins were later deprecated (2024) in favour of GPTs/apps — an early example of redesign.

timeline.title: Amazon Rufus beta (US-wide mid-2024)
timeline.significance: Largest merchant-controlled conversational shopping assistant; becomes the main source of company-claimed incremental sales.

timeline.title: Perplexity 'Buy with Pro' (one-click in-chat purchase for Pro subscribers, US)
timeline.significance: First consumer AI answer engine to offer in-chat checkout with third-party merchants.

timeline.title: OpenAI Operator (Computer-Using Agent) research preview
timeline.significance: Browser agent able to fill carts and check out on ordinary websites; benchmark scores show reliability gap (WebArena 58.1%).

timeline.title: Amazon 'Buy for Me' test: agent buys on third-party brand sites
timeline.significance: A marketplace operator's agent transacting on other retailers' sites, from inside Amazon's app.

timeline.title: Mastercard Agent Pay announced (agentic tokens)
timeline.significance: Card network creates tokenized credentials for agents; later enabled for all US cardholders at network level by late 2025.

timeline.title: Visa Intelligent Commerce announced
timeline.significance: Visa APIs/tokens for AI agents with partners incl. OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Perplexity, Stripe.

timeline.title: Google I/O: AI Mode shopping + agentic checkout preview
timeline.significance: Google begins converting search into conversational shopping with an agent that buys when price targets hit.

timeline.title: Walmart announces four 'super agents' (Sparky, Associate, Marty, Developer)
timeline.significance: Merchant-controlled agent strategy; Sparky to add reorder (replenishment) and event planning.

timeline.title: Google Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) with 60+ partners
timeline.significance: Mandate-based (intent/cart/payment) verifiable authorization for agent payments; addresses delegation/authorization gap.

timeline.title: ChatGPT Instant Checkout + Agentic Commerce Protocol (with Stripe); Etsy live, Shopify 'coming soon'
timeline.significance: First native checkout in a mass-market assistant (US, Etsy sellers first); ACP open-sourced; Stripe Shared Payment Tokens.

timeline.title: McKinsey projects up to $1T US / $3–5T global agentic-commerce 'orchestrated' revenue by 2030
timeline.significance: Most-cited market projection (goods only, B2C); a projection, not a measurement.

timeline.title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
timeline.significance: Lets merchants distinguish trusted agents from malicious bots (agent identity); no payment token issued.

timeline.title: Walmart–OpenAI partnership: buy Walmart items via ChatGPT Instant Checkout (live Nov 2025, ~200,000 products)
timeline.significance: Largest retailer to sell natively inside ChatGPT; outcome later disclosed as poor conversion.

timeline.title: PayPal Agentic Commerce Services (Store Sync, Agent Ready) + PayPal in ChatGPT announced for 2026
timeline.significance: Wallet provider positions as credential layer across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google.

timeline.title: Amazon Q3 2025: Rufus used by 250M customers in 2025, on track for >$10B annualized incremental sales
timeline.significance: Strongest company-claimed economic-value figure for any AI shopping assistant (internal 'downstream impact' attribution).

timeline.title: Singles' Day 2025: Alibaba's 'first large-scale deployment of generative AI' on Taobao/Tmall
timeline.significance: Company attributes double-digit gains to Qwen-powered search/recommendation; independent observers sceptical.

timeline.title: Amazon sues Perplexity over Comet shopping agent (after cease-and-desist)
timeline.significance: First major legal test of whether a consumer's agent may shop a retailer's site without the retailer's consent.

timeline.title: Google: agentic checkout in Search/AI Mode (Wayfair, Chewy, Quince, select Shopify merchants) + 'Let Google Call' stores
timeline.significance: Agent buys automatically when tracked price hits user budget (Google Pay); Duplex calls local stores for price/stock.

timeline.title: ChatGPT 'shopping research' launched; excludes sites (e.g., Amazon) that block OpenAI agents
timeline.significance: Discovery is constrained by retailer access policy (robots.txt).

timeline.title: Perplexity Instant Buy with PayPal free for all US users
timeline.significance: In-chat checkout made free, with launch promotion (50% back up to $50) — subsidised adoption.

timeline.title: Shopify Winter '26 Edition: Agentic Storefronts (syndicate catalog to ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, AI Mode)
timeline.significance: Platform-level merchant readiness: catalog syndication on by default.

timeline.title: Instacart app in ChatGPT with full in-chat checkout via ACP/Stripe
timeline.significance: First ChatGPT app with end-to-end checkout; grocery is a high-frequency, replenishment-like category.

timeline.title: DoorDash grocery app in ChatGPT (checkout hands off to DoorDash app)
timeline.significance: Merchant keeps checkout — the pattern most of the market moves to in 2026.

timeline.title: Microsoft Copilot Checkout (US) with PayPal, Shopify, Stripe
timeline.significance: Merchant remains merchant-of-record; Shopify merchants auto-enrolled after opt-out window.

timeline.title: Google Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) at NRF; checkout in AI Mode/Gemini; Walmart–Gemini partnership
timeline.significance: Open standard co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart; Google Pay initial credential provider; compatible with AP2/A2A/MCP.

timeline.title: Google 'Direct Offers' ads pilot in AI Mode
timeline.significance: Paid placement enters AI shopping answers.

timeline.title: Qwen app connects Taobao, Taobao Instant Commerce, Alipay (AI Pay), Fliggy, Amap
timeline.significance: Super-app-style agent completing orders and payments inside one chat (China).

timeline.title: Ads begin in ChatGPT (US pilot)
timeline.significance: Monetisation shifts from transaction fees toward advertising; sponsored placement in AI answers.

timeline.title: Alipay: AI Pay exceeded 120M transactions in one week (Feb 5–11)
timeline.significance: Largest claimed agentic payment volume anywhere; coincides with subsidised Qwen Chinese New Year campaign.

timeline.title: Mastercard Agent Pay: first live end-to-end agent payment in Europe (Santander)
timeline.significance: Controlled live transaction on production banking rails.

timeline.title: The Information reports OpenAI scaling back Instant Checkout
timeline.significance: Market leader retreats from native checkout; only ~12–30 Shopify merchants were live.

timeline.title: Court grants Amazon preliminary injunction blocking Perplexity Comet shopping on Amazon
timeline.significance: Retailer consent upheld at first instance (stayed by Ninth Circuit about a week later).

timeline.title: Amazon expands Buy for Me / Shop Direct via third-party feeds (claims 100M+ products, 400k+ stores)
timeline.significance: Amazon scales its own outbound agent while blocking inbound third-party agents.

timeline.title: Stripe/Tempo Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) launched
timeline.significance: Adds HTTP-level machine payments (stablecoins + cards via SPTs); protocol proliferation continues.

timeline.title: OpenAI 'Powering Product Discovery in ChatGPT': checkout moves to merchants/apps; ACP extended to discovery feeds
timeline.significance: Official redesign: ChatGPT focuses on discovery; Target, Sephora, Nordstrom support new feed experience.

timeline.title: Walmart ends Instant Checkout pilot; Sparky app launches inside ChatGPT (Gemini to follow April)
timeline.significance: Walmart disclosed in-chat purchases converted at ~1/3 the rate of click-outs; retailer-controlled agent embedded in third-party assistant instead.

timeline.title: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect (single integration across TAP, ACP, UCP, MPP)
timeline.significance: Network acts as protocol aggregator; Visa cites 'hundreds' of controlled real-world agent transactions.

timeline.title: Qwen gets full Taobao/Tmall catalogue (>4B items) with Alipay checkout
timeline.significance: End-to-end agentic shopping across China's largest catalogue.

timeline.title: Amazon retires Rufus brand; launches 'Alexa for Shopping' (Rufus + Alexa+) in search bar
timeline.significance: Redesign/rebrand toward agentic actions (price tracking, auto-buy).

timeline.title: Google Universal Cart (cross-merchant cart across Search, Gemini; YouTube/Gmail later)
timeline.significance: Cart-level aggregation on UCP with Nike, Sephora, Target, Ulta, Walmart, Wayfair, Shopify merchants named.

timeline.title: Google Marketing Live: Direct Offers expand into AI Mode responses; AI-powered shopping ads
timeline.significance: Sponsored placement in AI answers scales.

timeline.title: Amazon Alexa+ Agentic Ads (purchase inside the ad conversation)
timeline.significance: Advertising and transaction merge inside an agent conversation.

timeline.title: Mastercard: all European issuers enabled for Agent Pay; Worldline/ING first production agentic payment
timeline.significance: Network-level readiness ≠ consumer adoption; no volumes disclosed.

timeline.title: Ninth Circuit vacates Amazon's injunction: the human user, not Perplexity, 'accesses' Amazon under CFAA
timeline.significance: Weakens anti-hacking statutes as a tool to block user-directed agents; Amazon may still rely on terms of service.

timeline.title: Walmart Q2 FY27: Sparky users +70% YoY; users spend 40% more per order
timeline.significance: Company-reported correlation; no controlled incrementality disclosed.

timeline.title: Walmart Agent Gateway (MCP-based, invite-only beta) and Agent Profiles with spending limits
timeline.significance: Retailer-defined rules for third-party agents (separate agent order history, caps, approval, no card data to agents) — opposite of Amazon's blocking stance.

timeline.title: McKinsey survey (~21,000 consumers, 11 markets): 53% used AI for shopping; 14% of AI users completed a purchase via AI
timeline.significance: Best cross-market evidence separating discovery from execution.

timeline.title: Shopify Q3 2026: AI-referred traffic 2.6x, AI-referred orders 3.3x YoY; volume 'small', share undisclosed
timeline.significance: Growth is fast from a small base; GMV share not disclosed.

timeline.title: Amazon: text-message shopping with Alexa for Shopping (invite-only US); claims 400M users in 12 months, agentic-feature users 8x since Jan 2026
timeline.significance: Company-claimed scale of agentic features (auto-buy, price alerts) inside a closed ecosystem.

initiatives.name: ChatGPT shopping (search results, shopping research, product discovery feeds)
initiatives.what: Conversational product discovery inside ChatGPT; since Mar 2026 fed by merchant feeds via ACP and Shopify Catalog.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Available to all ChatGPT tiers; no OpenAI-disclosed purchase, click-out or repeat metrics.
initiatives.companyClaims: Retailers such as Target, Sephora, Nordstrom support the new feed experience; results described as organic.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Single-source observation (Sept 2026) that shopping results appear only from brands sending feeds; Amazon excluded because it blocks OpenAI agents.
initiatives.status2026: Live; core of OpenAI commerce strategy after checkout scale-back; now monetised through ads.

initiatives.name: Instant Checkout (native checkout in ChatGPT)
initiatives.what: Buy single items inside ChatGPT from Etsy, select Shopify merchants and Walmart using ACP + Stripe Shared Payment Tokens.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Limited production: US only; Etsy sellers plus roughly 12 (Forrester) to ~30 (Shopify) Shopify merchants and ~200k Walmart products. Walmart reported conversion at ~1/3 of click-outs. Forrester: consumer uptake 'low and stagnant'.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Walmart's disclosed conversion gap; Forrester merchant count; widespread reporting of the March 2026 retreat.
initiatives.status2026: Scaled back March 2026: checkout moved to merchant sites/apps; ChatGPT-hosted payment sheet reportedly persists in private beta for select marketplaces (secondary sources).

initiatives.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) + Shared Payment Tokens
initiatives.what: Open protocol for agent-to-merchant checkout; SPTs are scoped, time-limited payment credentials that avoid exposing raw card data.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Used in production by Instacart's ChatGPT app and Microsoft Copilot Checkout (via Stripe); extended in Mar 2026 to product feeds/discovery. No public transaction volume.
initiatives.companyClaims: Stripe: SPTs extended to network tokens and BNPL; partnerships with Google, Meta, OpenAI, Microsoft (Sessions 2026).
initiatives.independentEvidence: None found on volume; Stripe's John Collison reportedly said agentic stats only began rising sharply in Sept 2026 (secondary, no figures).
initiatives.status2026: Live; repositioned toward discovery + app checkout.

initiatives.name: Merchant apps in ChatGPT (Instacart, DoorDash, Walmart Sparky)
initiatives.what: Merchant-controlled experiences inside ChatGPT; Instacart checks out in-chat, DoorDash and Walmart hand off to their own apps/sites.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Commercially deployed in US; no disclosed order volumes. Walmart Sparky-in-ChatGPT reportedly converts at ~70% of Walmart.com rate (TechBuzz via secondary sources; weak).
initiatives.companyClaims: Instacart: first full in-chat checkout app.
initiatives.status2026: Live; this 'merchant agent inside the assistant' pattern became the 2026 default.

initiatives.name: Ads in ChatGPT (incl. shopping ads from product catalogs)
initiatives.what: Sponsored placements in ChatGPT for Free/Go tiers; self-serve tools and catalog-generated shopping ads.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Commercially deployed (paid by advertisers); UK expansion reported June 2026 (secondary).
initiatives.companyClaims: OpenAI going after brand ad budgets rather than transaction cuts (Digiday characterisation).
initiatives.independentEvidence: Vendor (Lengow) early performance notes; no audited data. A Sept 2026 Amazon DSP pilot to sell ChatGPT ads is single-source/unverified.
initiatives.status2026: Live and expanding.

initiatives.name: AI Mode / Gemini shopping (discovery, price tracking, Let Google Call)
initiatives.what: Conversational shopping in Search and Gemini over the Shopping Graph; Duplex calls local stores on the user's behalf.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Deployed to US users; 'Let Google Call' limited to select categories; no usage metrics disclosed for shopping.
initiatives.companyClaims: Google positions AI Mode as main shopping surface.
initiatives.status2026: Live; ads (Direct Offers, shopping ads) entering AI Mode responses in 2026.

initiatives.name: Agentic checkout / UCP-powered checkout in AI Mode & Gemini (Google Pay)
initiatives.what: Buy-button and auto-buy-at-target-price on eligible listings; merchant of record retained; native or embedded checkout options.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Limited production: 'available for selected merchants'; US with planned Canada/Australia/UK; Gemini app integration was 'coming soon' in docs; Feb 2026 reporting says checkout live only with Etsy/Wayfair products in AI Mode.
initiatives.companyClaims: Co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart; 20+ endorsers incl. Visa, Mastercard, Stripe; PayPal support 'coming soon'.
initiatives.status2026: Expanding (Universal Cart, May 2026); breadth of live merchants unverified.

initiatives.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
initiatives.what: Open standard covering discovery, checkout and post-purchase; compatible with AP2, A2A, MCP.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Live with select merchants in Google surfaces; also used by Microsoft Copilot Checkout per Shopify docs and supported by PayPal Agent Ready. Partnership/endorsement counts are not adoption.
initiatives.status2026: Live, expanding; part of a fragmented protocol landscape (ACP, AP2, TAP, MPP, x402, Alibaba ACTP).

initiatives.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
initiatives.what: Signed, verifiable mandates (intent/cart/payment) proving what a user authorised an agent to buy.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Spec and reference implementations public with 60+ launch partners; no disclosed production transaction volume found.
initiatives.companyClaims: 60+ partners (Mastercard, PayPal, Amex, Coinbase, Adyen, Worldpay, Salesforce); later claims of 100+.
initiatives.status2026: Referenced as compatible layer under UCP; standalone adoption unverified.

initiatives.name: Universal Cart
initiatives.what: Cross-merchant, cross-surface cart (Search, Gemini; YouTube/Gmail later) with price-drop and restock tracking; checkout on UCP.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Announced at I/O with named merchants ('try these select checkout features soon'); one vendor source says shopper access opened at start of 2026 holiday season — unverified.
initiatives.companyClaims: Launch merchants: Nike, Sephora, Target, Ulta, Walmart, Wayfair, Shopify brands.
initiatives.status2026: Rolling out (US); status unverified.

initiatives.name: Rufus → Alexa for Shopping (merchant-controlled assistant, price alerts, auto-buy)
initiatives.what: Conversational assistant inside Amazon; since May 2026 rebranded 'Alexa for Shopping' with agentic actions (price-drop auto-buy, comparisons, text ordering).
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Rated 6 on company-claimed evidence only: >$10B annualized incremental sales (internal 7-day 'downstream impact' attribution), 250M users 2025 (later restated as 300M), 400M users in 12 months to Nov 2026, agentic-feature users 8x since Jan 2026. Not independently audited.
initiatives.companyClaims: Rufus users 60% more likely to purchase; users spend 50% more (Amazon) / 40% more (Q2 2026 filing per McKinsey).
initiatives.independentEvidence: None independent; correlation between engagement and spend likely confounded by user selection.
initiatives.status2026: Live; Rufus brand retired 2026-05-13; text shopping invite-only from 2026-11-06.

initiatives.name: Buy for Me / Shop Direct
initiatives.what: Amazon's agent buys on third-party brand websites; user confirms on Amazon checkout page.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Test with a subset of US users; Mar 2026 feed expansion (claims 100M+ products, 400k+ stores). No usage/order data.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Brand pushback Jan 2026 over listings resembling Amazon pages.
initiatives.status2026: Expanding; still described as limited.

initiatives.name: Alexa+ Agentic Ads
initiatives.what: Ads that complete purchases inside the Alexa+ conversation.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Launch partners (e.g., Papa Johns, concert tickets); no performance data.
initiatives.status2026: Live with partners.

initiatives.name: Sparky (in-app super agent)
initiatives.what: Merchant-controlled assistant in Walmart app; planned reorder/replenishment and event planning.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Commercially deployed at scale; ~half of app users had tried it (Feb 2026); users +70% YoY (Aug 2026). AOV gap is correlational; no incrementality or repeat-purchase disclosure.
initiatives.independentEvidence: None; analysts note no controlled comparison.
initiatives.status2026: Live; also embedded in ChatGPT (Mar 2026) and Gemini (planned Apr 2026).

initiatives.name: Walmart Instant Checkout in ChatGPT
initiatives.what: ~200k Walmart products purchasable natively in ChatGPT.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Limited production; in-chat conversion ~1/3 of click-through (Walmart's Danker to WIRED); inaccurate items reportedly added to carts.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Walmart's own disclosure is the best evidence of a native-checkout shortfall.
initiatives.status2026: Ended March 2026; replaced by Sparky app in ChatGPT (relationship continues, model changed).

initiatives.name: Walmart & Sam's Club shopping in Gemini (UCP, Google Pay)
initiatives.what: Basket building and checkout inside Gemini with account linking.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Announced without launch date; Sparky-in-Gemini planned for April 2026; live status of native checkout not confirmed in sources found.
initiatives.status2026: Unverified.

initiatives.name: Agent Gateway + Agent Profiles
initiatives.what: MCP-based access for approved third-party agents; per-agent profiles with spending caps/approval; agents never receive card data.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Invite-only beta for developers; profiles 'within the next month'; no named launch agents.
initiatives.companyClaims: Rules: agents must not exceed shopper intent; non-compliant agents blocked.
initiatives.status2026: Beta.

initiatives.name: Shopify Catalog + Agentic Storefronts (+ Checkout Kit / UCP / ACP)
initiatives.what: Syndicates merchant catalogs to ChatGPT, Copilot, AI Mode/Gemini (and Perplexity per some sources); checkout via Copilot Checkout/UCP or merchant storefront.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Deployed across major AI channels; AI-referred orders 3.3x YoY in Q3 2026 but absolute volume/GMV share undisclosed and described by management as 'small'.
initiatives.companyClaims: AI-attributed orders 11x Jan 2025→Jan 2026 (secondary); 74% of AI-attributed purchases outside top-100 categories (Q3 2026).
initiatives.independentEvidence: Investors sold shares after Q3 2026 citing early payoff (secondary).
initiatives.status2026: Live; channel breadth varies (AI Mode/Gemini limited to select US shops).

initiatives.name: Qwen app agentic shopping (Taobao, Tmall, Instant Commerce, Fliggy, Amap)
initiatives.what: Single chat agent that orders food, books travel and buys from Taobao/Tmall with Alipay.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Commercially deployed in China; company claims 120M+ consumer orders in Feb 6–11 CNY campaign (heavily subsidised), Qwen 100M MAU within 2 months, 300M MAU across surfaces. Repeat/unsubsidised behaviour not shown.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Analyst note: <10M DAU in early Feb 2026 (single source).
initiatives.status2026: Live; centrepiece of Singles' Day 2026 (results pending on 2026-11-11).

initiatives.name: Alipay AI Pay
initiatives.what: Payment rail for AI agents in Qwen, merchant mini-programs (e.g., Luckin), smart glasses.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Rated 6 on company-claimed measurable volume: >120M transactions in week of Feb 5–11 2026; >100M users (Feb 24 2026). Not audited; coincided with subsidy campaign.
initiatives.companyClaims: 'World's first' agentic payment service at this scale.
initiatives.independentEvidence: NielsenIQ republished figure but explicitly did not measure it.
initiatives.status2026: Live.

initiatives.name: Taobao/Tmall AI assistants (Singles' Day 2025)
initiatives.what: Gen-AI search, recommendation, shopping assistant and merchant tools.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Deployed at scale; company attributes GMV gains to AI; ~300M inquiries handled by an assistant (secondary).
initiatives.companyClaims: Strongest Tmall Singles' Day GMV growth in four years (company).
initiatives.independentEvidence: Inside Retail: results 'far from explosive'; no neutral attribution.
initiatives.status2026: Live.

initiatives.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce / Trusted Agent Protocol / Intelligent Commerce Connect
initiatives.what: Agent tokens, agent identity signalling for merchants, single integration across protocols.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: 'Hundreds' of controlled real-world agent-initiated transactions; live B2B pilot with BILL/Billtrust.
initiatives.status2026: Live pilots; aggregating protocols.

initiatives.name: Agent Pay (agentic tokens)
initiatives.what: Tokenised credentials bound to registered agents.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: All US cardholders enabled at network level by late 2025; first live (controlled) European transaction Mar 2026; all European issuers enabled June 2026. Enablement ≠ usage; no volumes.
initiatives.status2026: Live at network level.

initiatives.name: Agentic commerce services (Store Sync, Agent Ready), Perplexity Instant Buy, Copilot Checkout, ChatGPT checkout
initiatives.what: Wallet credentials and catalog sync for AI surfaces.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Perplexity Instant Buy and Copilot Checkout live in US; Agent Ready documented as live (Oct 2026) for ACP/Braintree and UCP. ChatGPT checkout with PayPal still 'coming soon' on PayPal consumer page — not confirmed live.
initiatives.status2026: Partly live; ChatGPT component overtaken by OpenAI's March 2026 redesign.

initiatives.name: Buy with Pro → Instant Buy; Comet browser agent
initiatives.what: In-chat checkout (PayPal) and an agentic browser that can shop on sites.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Deployed to US users; no transaction data. Comet's Amazon shopping contested in court.
initiatives.independentEvidence: Court record: Amazon alleges Comet iOS copied auth cookies to Perplexity cloud (Mar–May 2026) — allegation, not finding.
initiatives.status2026: Live; Amazon litigation ongoing (motion to dismiss pending).

initiatives.name: Copilot Checkout (+ Brand Agents)
initiatives.what: In-chat checkout in Copilot with PayPal, Shopify, Stripe; merchant of record retained.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Commercially deployed in US; Shopify merchants auto-enrolled; no volume disclosed.
initiatives.companyClaims: Journeys including Copilot led to 53% more purchases within 30 minutes (Microsoft internal).
initiatives.status2026: Live; planned extension to Bing, Edge, MSN.

initiatives.name: Machine Payments Protocol (MPP)
initiatives.what: HTTP-level payment requests for agents; stablecoin and card (via SPT) settlement.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Live with early adopters; no volume.
initiatives.status2026: Live/preview.

initiatives.name: x402 (HTTP 402 stablecoin payments)
initiatives.what: Machine-to-machine micropayments for agents/APIs.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Coinbase CEO claimed >160M transactions by June 2026 (secondary). Mostly API/machine payments, not consumer retail checkout; composition of volume unverified.
initiatives.status2026: Live; marginal to consumer retail.

initiatives.name: General browser agents (Operator/ChatGPT agent, Project Mariner, Comet)
initiatives.what: Agents that navigate retailer sites and fill carts like a human.
initiatives.maturityEvidence: Shipped to paying users; benchmark success well below humans; retailers increasingly block or gate them (Amazon robots.txt; Walmart gateway).
initiatives.status2026: Live but shopping use undisclosed; shifting to sanctioned APIs/protocols.

rollbacks.what: ChatGPT plugins (incl. Instacart, Shopify, Klarna shopping plugins, March 2023) wound down in favour of GPTs/apps — first-generation conversational-commerce integration discontinued.
Seller/brand pushback against Buy for Me listing brand products in Amazon-like pages without opt-in.

Gemini app UCP checkout listed as 'coming soon' in Google docs; Walmart–Gemini in-chat checkout announced without a launch date — live status not confirmed in sources found (possible slip, unverified).
Missed target: Sept 2025 promise of >1M Shopify merchants 'coming soon' vs roughly 12 (Forrester) to ~30 (Shopify) merchants live by Feb–Mar 2026.

The Information reports OpenAI scaling back ChatGPT Instant Checkout; OpenAI spokesperson: Instant Checkout moving to Apps, focus on discovery. Forrester notes OpenAI's language of 'temporary'/'scale back'.
Official redesign ('Powering Product Discovery in ChatGPT'): first version 'did not offer the level of flexibility' desired; purchases completed on merchant sites/apps; ACP extended to product feeds.
PayPal checkout inside ChatGPT (announced 2025-10-28 for 2026) not confirmed live; PayPal consumer page still says 'coming soon' while OpenAI moved checkout to merchants.
Walmart ends Instant Checkout pilot (~200k products since Nov 2025) after in-chat conversion ran ~1/3 of click-through; replaces it with its own Sparky app in ChatGPT and Gemini.
Rufus brand discontinued; replaced by 'Alexa for Shopping' (redesign/rebrand; underlying tech retained).
Ninth Circuit vacates Amazon's preliminary injunction against Perplexity Comet (stayed ~a week after March 2026 grant): reversal of Amazon's first-instance legal win.

problems.problem: Native in-agent checkout underperforms the retailer's own funnel
problems.evidence: Walmart: in-ChatGPT conversion ~1/3 of click-outs; wrong items in carts; Forrester: uptake low and stagnant; OpenAI and Walmart both retreated to merchant-hosted checkout (Mar 2026).
problems.whyNew: E-commerce spent 25 years optimising owned checkout, accounts, loyalty, and saved payment; an agent surface strips these out and inserts a new trust step.

problems.problem: Delegation and authorization: proving what the user actually authorised
problems.evidence: AP2 mandates (intent/cart/payment); Walmart Agent Profiles with spending caps and per-purchase approval; Google auto-buy only within user-set budget; Amazon alleges Comet copied users' auth cookies.
problems.whyNew: Card-not-present rules assume a human pressing 'buy'; agents act asynchronously and may exceed intent.

problems.problem: Agent identity and access: telling sanctioned agents from bots, and who may block whom
problems.evidence: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol; Amazon robots.txt blocks OpenAI/Anthropic/Perplexity agents; Ninth Circuit (Aug 2026) held the human user, not Perplexity, 'accesses' Amazon under CFAA, leaving ToS as Amazon's main lever; Walmart gateway is invite-only.
problems.whyNew: Web commerce had bots vs humans; now there are user-directed agents with a legitimate principal.

problems.problem: Liability, disputes and chargebacks for agent-made purchases
problems.evidence: No settled network rule for 'agent error' vs 'unauthorised'; Mastercard/Visa building tokenised agent credentials and dispute frameworks; merchants remain merchant-of-record in Copilot/UCP flows; Walmart rule that agents never receive card data. No public dispute-rate data found.
problems.whyNew: Reg E/Reg Z and network chargeback reason codes predate agents; who bears loss when an agent misreads intent is unresolved.

problems.evidence: WebArena (2023): best GPT-4 agent 14.4% vs humans 78.2%; WebShop (2022): ~29% vs ~60% human experts; OpenAI CUA (Jan 2025): 58.1% WebArena, 87% WebVoyager; Walmart reported inaccurate products pushed into carts.
problems.whyNew: A 5–40% failure rate is tolerable for search, not for spending money.

problems.problem: Incentives and sponsored placement inside AI answers
problems.evidence: ChatGPT ads (US pilot Feb 2026, self-serve and catalog shopping ads by May 2026); Google Direct Offers in AI Mode (Jan→May 2026); Amazon Alexa+ Agentic Ads (June 2026); single-source claim that ChatGPT results come only from feed-sending brands.
problems.whyNew: Agent recommendations collapse a results page into one answer; paid influence is less visible than ranked ads.

problems.evidence: Amazon blocks external agents but runs its own outbound Buy for Me (brands objected); Walmart APIs require partner approval; merchants insist on merchant-of-record status and customer relationship; account linking (Walmart–Gemini) needed for personalisation.
problems.whyNew: Whoever holds the agent holds intent data and the customer relationship — the 'aggregator' fight of e-commerce repeats at the agent layer.

problems.evidence: ACP (OpenAI/Stripe), UCP (Google+coalition), AP2, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay, MPP (Stripe/Tempo), x402 (Coinbase), Alibaba ACTP; Visa ICC and PayPal Agent Ready exist to bridge them.
problems.whyNew: Merchants must integrate multiple standards before demand is proven.

problems.evidence: Amazon uses internal 7-day 'downstream impact'; Walmart and Amazon report user-vs-non-user spend gaps (selection bias); Shopify reports growth multiples without base or GMV share; 'influenced' vs 'executed' sales conflated in industry stats.
problems.whyNew: No common definition of an 'agentic sale', so headline numbers are not comparable.

problems.evidence: EU AI Act in force (Aug 2024; GPAI obligations from Aug 2025) but not commerce-agent specific; US case law via Amazon v. Perplexity (CFAA/CDAFA narrow ruling); card-network rules being written privately. No CFPB agent-commerce rule identified in this session.
problems.whyNew: Rules arrive through litigation and private network rulebooks rather than statute.

conflicts: Instant Checkout retreat dating: The Information report (2026-03-05), CNBC confirmation (2026-03-20) and OpenAI's official post (2026-03-24); some coverage calls it a 'shutdown', Forrester notes OpenAI used 'temporary'/'scale back', and secondary sources say a ChatGPT-hosted payment sheet survives in private beta for select marketplaces.
Shopify merchants live on Instant Checkout: ~12 (Forrester) vs ~30 (Shopify, to Forrester); a 'fewer than fifteen' figure also circulates.

Walmart–OpenAI: some headlines ('Walmart fires OpenAI') imply a break; reporting shows Walmart ended native Instant Checkout but launched its Sparky app inside ChatGPT — the partnership changed form, not ended.
Amazon spend uplift: Amazon says Alexa for Shopping users spend 50% more; McKinsey cites Amazon's Q2 2026 filing at 40% (US).
Rufus 2025 users: 250M (Q3 2025 call) vs 300M+ (May 2026 statement covering all of 2025); MAU growth reported as 140% (most sources) vs 149% (one source).
Rufus 'retired' vs 'rebranded': Amazon retained Rufus technology under Alexa for Shopping (May 2026); one source claims it can buy outside Amazon — unconfirmed.
Amazon v. Perplexity injunction date: 2026-03-09 vs 2026-03-10 across outlets; it was stayed ~a week later and vacated 2026-08-04.
AP2 mandate naming differs across sources (Intent/Cart/Payment vs Checkout/Payment); launch partner count 60+ vs later claims of 100+.

Google UCP checkout breadth: Google says 'select merchants'; Feb 2026 reporting says AI Mode checkout live only with Etsy and Wayfair products; one vendor says Universal Cart opened to shoppers at the start of the 2026 holiday season — not confirmed by Google sources seen.
Shopify ChatGPT fee: a 4% fee on ChatGPT checkout sales was reported (PYMNTS), while other sources say there is no extra fee; current terms unverified.
Qwen '400' figure: described variously as 400+ services, 400+ features, or 400 office functions — not a single metric.
Qwen/Alipay volumes (Feb 2026) overlap with a subsidised Chinese New Year campaign; Alibaba cites 120M+ orders (Feb 6–11) and ~200M orders elsewhere on a different definition.
Mastercard European 'firsts': Santander (2026-03-02, controlled live) vs Worldline/ING (2026-06-02, first 'in production').

Projections diverge by an order of magnitude by definition: McKinsey up to $1T US / $3–5T global (goods, 'orchestrated') vs Morgan Stanley $190–385B and Bain $300–500B (US) vs eMarketer ~$144B (secondary aggregator).
Perplexity Buy with Pro launch: Nov 2024 (majority) vs one source saying Black Friday 2025 (likely conflating with Instant Buy).
Shopify Q3 2026 post-earnings share drop reported as 7.49% vs 8.7%.
